procedural_matters: The hearing was conducted by a panel under N1.4(b).
facts: SUI 221579 was scored UFD in race 4.
A photos taken from the race committee vessel show SUI 221579 in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before her starting signal.
conclusions: SUI 221579 was identified as in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before her starting signal and broke RRS 30.3. 2.
SUI 221579’s score in race 6 was made significantly worse through her own fault. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b) are not met.
